meta.title: AgentBridge — Generic Environment & Connector Analyzer Architecture
meta.subtitle: Provider-Neutral Pipeline, Probing Engine, Evidence Model & Observability
meta.description: System architecture of the Phase 7.4 Generic Environment and Connector Analyzer in AgentBridge. Demonstrates provider-neutral descriptor consumption, multi-stage inspection pipeline, non-destructive OS/binary/client probing, ActivityStore evidence auditing, and in-process metrics recording without vendor conditionals.

components.label:
ConnectorRegistry
(sutra/connectors/registry.py)
components.description: Central in-process connector authority providing lifecycle management, registration hooks, and standardized ConnectorAnalysisDescriptor extraction.

components.label:
ConnectorAnalyzer
(sutra/connectors/analyzer/pipeline.py)
components.description: Single unified verification engine orchestrating 12 inspection stages with bounded concurrency semaphore and per-connector fault isolation.

components.label:
EnvironmentProbe
(sutra/connectors/analyzer/probes.py)
components.description: Safe platform discovery probing OS family, CPU architecture, Python runtime, working directory, and writable temp directories without dumping raw environment variables.

components.label:
CLIProbe
(sutra/connectors/analyzer/probes.py)
components.description: Non-destructive binary discovery using which/where.exe and sanitized --version checks with strict 3-second timeouts.

components.label:
ClientProbe
(sutra/connectors/analyzer/probes.py)
components.description: Workstation tool detector verifying presence, config paths, and versions of Cursor, VS Code, AgentBridge Runtime, and generic CLI agents.

components.label:
Analysis Models & Evidence
(sutra/connectors/analyzer/models.py)
components.description: Strict verification state machine (7 distinct states), 12 check categories, CheckStatus (PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/SKIPPED), and immutable AnalysisReport.

components.label:
ActivityStore
(sutra/activity_store.py)
components.description: Local SQLite audit trail recording verification events, latency diagnostics, check counts, and historical tool-call usage evidence.

components.label:
Metrics
(sutra/metrics.py)
components.description: In-process bounded metrics tracking analyzer_run_total, analyzer_run_success, and analyzer_run_error without cardinality explosion.

components.label:
PermissionEngine
(sutra/permissions.py)
components.description: Authoritative policy evaluator ensuring connector analysis operates within defined security boundaries and credential inspection remains redacted.
